description: 4781 Brockton Ave is the kind of home that rarely comes available — a true century-old Craftsman bungalow full of character, charm, and timeless architectural details in the highly desirable Wood Streets neighborhood of Riverside. Originally built in 1914, this beautiful single-story home offers 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, and approximately 1,176 square feet of living space filled with classic craftsmanship throughout. From the moment you arrive, the expansive front porch invites you to sit back, relax, and enjoy the charm of this historic neighborhood. Inside, you’ll find original built-ins, rich wood flooring, stunning wood beam ceilings, and the warmth and character that only a true Craftsman home can provide. The spacious galley-style kitchen offers plenty of functionality along with a large walk-in pantry, while the separate laundry room includes washer and gas dryer hookups for added convenience. Step outside to a generously sized backyard with room for gardening, entertaining, and possible RV parking potential. Ideally located just minutes from Downtown Riverside, shopping, dining, parks, schools, and freeway access, this home combines historic charm with everyday convenience. Opportunities like this do not come around often — put this one on your must-see list today! For more information or to schedule a private showing, please contact us.
